title: Assigned to me shows only my matching work orders in every display
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Work Orders page on the build under test, signed in with Work Orders view permission.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns. (A technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or not Time Clock User.) Add technicians if fewer show.
  3. Create several work orders across different lead technicians, leaving some Unassigned, via New Work Order (for example S2-17578, S2-17579, S2-17580).
  4. Assign a few of those work orders to yourself, the signed-in user, so "Assigned to me" has matches.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Work Orders page and switch to List.
  2. Turn on the "Assigned to me" filter.
  3. Read which work orders are listed.
  4. Switch to Tech View, then to Board View, and read which work orders show in each.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With "Assigned to me" enabled, every display option shows only the work orders that match the existing Assigned to me rules.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10044 — Switch between display options. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S1-R13 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
